content: Vercel Hobby (free) plan 2026: ~100GB bandwidth/mo, ~100K function invocations/mo, Fluid Compute default gives up to 300s execution (vs old 10s), Data Cache item size cap is 2MB per entry, Data Cache shared across all projects on a team (Hobby/Pro), LRU eviction when storage limit reached, 6000 build minutes/mo, 1 concurrent build. Exceeding limits pauses the project rather than auto-billing overage.
